files.FORMAT.md:
# Canonical release manifest v1

For each legacy object, write exactly:

- `schema_version`: integer `1`
- `release.name`: trimmed lowercase legacy `component`
- `release.version`: trimmed legacy `version` with one leading lowercase or uppercase `v` removed
- `enabled`: true only when trimmed case-insensitive legacy `enabled` is one of `yes`, `true`, or `1`
- `owners`: split the legacy pipe-delimited string, trim and lowercase non-empty entries, remove duplicates, sort alphabetically
- `labels`: split the legacy comma-delimited string, trim and lowercase non-empty entries, remove duplicates, sort alphabetically

Preserve no other fields.
